d: Short, fluffy platinum white hair with choppy bangs and a small black ribbon tied at the top. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a focused, intense expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build dressed in a stylized miko-inspired outfit consisting of a white short-sleeved top, a black pleated hakama skirt, and a black overcoat, accented with red cords and gold detailing. Accessories include dark grey fingerless gloves and a long, ornate red and gold spear.
